originalSubject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution

payload.subject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution
payload.text:
Hello CoinCodex team,

Thank you for forwarding the proposal. To make the review easier for the appropriate team, here is the compact package:

- Publication: https://hashtagweb3.com/news (Hashtag Web3 - United States organization, English-language crypto and Web3 news)
- RSS feed: https://hashtagweb3.com/news/feed.xml - headline, summary, original publication date, canonical link per item
- Example native article: https://hashtagweb3.com/bitgetthai
- About: https://hashtagweb3.com/about / Contact: hi@hashtagweb3.com
- Content scope: our native articles only. Our news listing also links to external publishers; those external stories are not supplied as our own content.
- AI disclosure: our workflow uses AI-assisted research and drafting with source and publication checks; tell us your required disclosure format and we will adopt it.
- Rights: attribution to Hashtag Web3 with canonical links; image-rights information for our original images available on request.

If useful, we can send the same package with sample full-content entries as files or via a sandbox feed URL.

Thank you,
Hashtag Web3 - hi@hashtagweb3.com
